_comment: Ten held-out Amazon Fashion questions, independent of questions_10q.json. Product categories are disjoint from the original ten (dress, shoe, shirt, jacket, hat, watch, bag, sock, sandal, costume) and the semantic predicates deliberately span different axes -- durability, adjustability, optical function, tactile comfort, laundering, dimension, sizing accuracy, colour fidelity, support and opacity -- with a mix of positive and negative polarity. Structured candidate counts in the evaluation split were validated against work/canonical/structured.csv; the smallest is 314, well above structured_candidate_pool_size (50).

questions.question: Which necklaces do reviewers say tarnish or discolour after a short time?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item tarnished, discoloured, turned the skin green, or lost its finish after a short period of use?

questions.question: Which bracelets are described by reviewers as adjustable enough to fit different wrist sizes?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item is adjustable, resizable, or fits a range of wrist sizes?

questions.question: Which sunglasses do reviewers say arrived scratched, bent, or broken?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item arrived scratched, bent, cracked, broken, or otherwise damaged?

questions.question: Which women's sweaters do reviewers describe as itchy or scratchy against the skin?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews describe the item as itchy, scratchy, or irritating against the skin?

questions.question: Which hoodies do reviewers say shrank or faded after washing?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item shrank, faded, stretched out, or otherwise degraded after being washed?

questions.question: Which leather wallets do reviewers describe as slim enough to carry in a pocket?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews describe the item as slim, thin, or compact enough to carry comfortably in a pocket?

questions.question: Which men's jeans do reviewers say run larger or smaller than the labelled size?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item runs larger or smaller than the labelled size, or that buyers should size up or down?

questions.question: Which scarves do reviewers say arrived in a colour different from the pictures?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item's colour differed from the photographs or the product description?

questions.question: Which women's swimsuits do reviewers say provide good support or coverage?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item provides good support, coverage, or stays securely in place?

questions.question: Which leggings do reviewers say are sheer or see-through when stretched?
questions.semantic_question: Do the reviews say the item is sheer, see-through, or too thin when stretched or worn?
